desc: Derive DP state definitions: g[v] = max vertices in valid partial alkane where v is included and uses its parent edge (v keeps exactly 3 children); leaf mode contributes 1; best[c] = max(1, g[c]).
Confirm answer = max over v of (1 + sum of top-4 best[c]) requiring ≥4 children; every alkane has a unique highest vertex relative to root, so enumeration is complete.
Write final iterative solution: build adjacency, iterative DFS post-order with parent tracking, compute top-3/top-4 child gains per node, output max or -1; O(N) time, recursion-free, fast I/O.
Verify against samples: Sample 1 → 8, Sample 2 → -1, Sample 3 → 11; check edge cases (N<5, star graphs, deep chains).
